integrity: Complete symbolic proof with standard intersection-theoretic inputs and two independent exact finite checks. No independent mathematical audit or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Degree is that of the reduced common stratum of the degree-two Chow components in the Chow-form embedding over C, for n>=3 and 1<=p<=n-2. It does not compute nonreduced intersection schemes, their multiplicities, or projective degrees for larger cycle degree. Numerical calculations test only n<=7, whereas the proof is all-parameter. Broader historical priority of the evaluated formulas remains open.
title: Projective degrees of the common incidence strata of degree-two Chow varieties
